description: This file defines an interface 'GroupRolesReadPlatformService' which declares methods for retrieving group roles and specific group role data within the Fineract project's group portfolio service layer.

classes.name: GroupRolesReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to read group roles data in the platform.

methods.name: retrieveGroupRoles
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of group roles associated with a specific group identified by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveGroupRole
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific role within a group, identified by group ID and role ID.
